how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Delhi to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Delhi to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Delhi (AIIMS Delhi) for various research and data entry positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Senior Research Fellow and Data Entry Operator positions under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What are the post names offered in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The posts available are Senior Research Fellow Ayurveda (PRS-I, Medical), Senior Research Fellow (PRS-I, Non-Medical), and Data Entry Operator.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Delhi Posts 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form and fill out the Google Form is 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for Senior Research Fellow (Medical)?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Senior Research Fellow Ayurveda post must possess a B.A.M.S. degree in Ayurveda from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are needed for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Data Entry Operator position must be Intermediate or 12th pass with a computer diploma or course and 2 years of relevant work experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the application fee is Nil for all categories including General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates as per the official notification details.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Senior Research Fellow and Data Entry Operator positions will be based on an interview, which may be conducted offline or online.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type and mode of application?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based government job opportunity, and candidates are required to submit their applications through online mode.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application links?
faq.answer: Candidates can access the official notification PDF, application links, and the official website directly from the Important Links section provided in this article.
